repair.description: When the interpolated sonic point leaves the tabulated entropy domain during deep expansion, locate the lowest admissible isentrope pressure and use its bounded flux instead of aborting the integration.
repair.safety_property: No extrapolation, parameter fitting or outcome-dependent coefficient change is introduced; the fallback remains inside the property-table domain.

repaired_post_access_replay.interpretation: Exploratory only because the model was repaired after the original outcomes were accessed.

next_step: Freeze the repaired implementation and score it on a new untouched campaign, such as an independent PRESLHY series or controlled-access release dataset, before making any validation claim.
claim_boundary: This repair removes a table-domain integration failure and demonstrates development improvement. It does not validate the full HRS fueling loop, a site vent stack, two-phase release, ignition, dispersion, emergency separation distance or SAGA effectiveness.
